description: A typed literal suffix. The object id is the suffix: a data type id or its typed literal short form that can follow a string literal in a script.

dataType.description: Id of the data type that parses the text of a typed literal with this suffix.
dataType.label: Data Type

typedLiteralShortForm.brief: Optional short form of the data type id
typedLiteralShortForm.description: Short form of the data type id that can be used as the suffix, if the data type has one.
typedLiteralShortForm.label: Typed Literal Short Form
